item.title: Canada: RTR launch set for 9 November

item.title: Canada–EU: interlink work supported
item.description: Preview, pending Avi’s review. A joint commitment supports work toward connecting instant payment systems. It is not an operating cross-border route. Who: Cross-border product and treasury teams. Effective: Not confirmed / not applicable. Official source: https://www.payments.ca/payments-canada-welcomes-joint-canada-eu-commitment-interlink-real-time-payment-systems
